sources.fullCitation: Ilja Livschakoff Tanz-Orchester, with German refrain vocal by L. Monosson. “Süße Mamsell, denkst du noch an das kleine Hotel.” Tango; words by Fritz Rotter; music by Bronisław Kaper. Grammophon B 51043, Bestell-Nr. 23179, side 2, n.d. [not before 1930]. Label visible via Radiomuseum Hardthausen / Schallarchiv online upload.
